records.specialReason: UPRP record builder; not a trigger row
records.doc: Build the normalized 20-byte UPRP record consumed by CreateUnitWithProperties. Not a trigger row; the record is always hand-built.

assumptions: This file is the single source of truth for the 79 stock rows (22 conditions + 57 actions) and the 13 eudkit extension helper rows.
UnitProperty is a record row, not one of the 92 trigger rows; it is listed separately so the five documented special rows are visible in one place.

The partial tests/stock-trigger-catalog.json and its runners were retired in ticket #5; this spec plus the frozen goldens in tests/stock-row-goldens.json supersede them, and the docs, LSP, and export surfaces derive from this file.

Emitted HIR is unchanged by this artifact: the frozen goldens in tests/stock-row-goldens.json were captured from the current hand-written helpers before any emitter change; the rows carry no HIR version field, so they stay valid across version bumps (3.1 at capture, 3.2 since ADR 0021).
Deaths/SetDeaths keep class 'stock'; their target forms are the only place the PlayerOrFieldTarget / ValueOrPtrTarget extension target form appears.
